 ubuntu/lp-2072564-elfload-Fix-alignment-when-unmapping-excess-reservat.patch

index 0000000..8a335d0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp-2123828-fix-riscv-endianness.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+Description: Fix RISC-V instructions endianness (LP: #2123828)
+ Some compressed RISC-V instructions were not using MO_TE, needed to
+ swap endianness if host and emulated machines are not the same.
+ Fixes that by adding the missing flag.
+ .
+ qemu (1:9.2.1+ds-1ubuntu5.3) plucky; urgency=medium
+ .
+   * Fix RISC-V instructions endianness (LP: #2123828)
+Author: Valentin Haudiquet <valentin.haudiquet@canonical.com>
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2123828
+Bug: https://gitlab.com/qemu-project/qemu/-/issues/3131
+Applied-Upstream: https://gitlab.com/qemu-project/qemu/-/commit/b25133d38fe693589cf695b85968caa0724bfafd
+---
+--- qemu-10.1.0+ds.orig/target/riscv/insn_trans/trans_rvzce.c.inc
++++ qemu-10.1.0+ds/target/riscv/insn_trans/trans_rvzce.c.inc
+@@ -88,13 +88,13 @@ static bool trans_c_lbu(DisasContext *ct
+ static bool trans_c_lhu(DisasContext *ctx, arg_c_lhu *a)
+ {
+     REQUIRE_ZCB(ctx);
+-    return gen_load(ctx, a, MO_UW);
++    return gen_load(ctx, a, MO_TEUW);
+ }
+ 
+ static bool trans_c_lh(DisasContext *ctx, arg_c_lh *a)
+ {
+     REQUIRE_ZCB(ctx);
+-    return gen_load(ctx, a, MO_SW);
++    return gen_load(ctx, a, MO_TESW);
+ }
+ 
+ static bool trans_c_sb(DisasContext *ctx, arg_c_sb *a)
+@@ -106,7 +106,7 @@ static bool trans_c_sb(DisasContext *ctx
+ static bool trans_c_sh(DisasContext *ctx, arg_c_sh *a)
+ {
+     REQUIRE_ZCB(ctx);
+-    return gen_store(ctx, a, MO_UW);
++    return gen_store(ctx, a, MO_TEUW);
+ }
+ 
+ #define X_S0    8
